messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: A minor change to rApache
parts:
All,

I'm planning on bumping the minor number to 2, e.g. the next release
will be 1.2.0 because...

1.2.0 will set the working directory to a sensible place when using
RFileEval, RFileHandler, or r-script.

For instance with a Rook deployment like this:

<Location /hmisc>
SetHandler r-handler
RFileEval "/home/hornerj/Hmisc/config.R:Rook::Server$call(app)"
</Location>

It makes sense to change the working directory to
"/home/hornerj/Hmisc". That way, the examples in the Rook package can
work without change.

Also, for:

<Directory /home/hornerj/rapache/test/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

and a request of /home/hornerj/rapache/test/brew/simple.html, it
makes sense to set the working directory to
"/home/hornerj/rapache/test/brew". Or if the request was
/home/hornerj/rapache/test/brew/subdir/foo.html, it makes sense to set
it to /home/hornerj/rapache/test/brew/subdir.

Comments?

Jeff

parts:
Here's how I set up a virtual machine to test RApache and Rook for the
webapps I want to build:

a. I decided to use a virtual machine from Windows Azure Cloud
(free for 90 days)
b. I chose this operating system: Ubuntu 12.04 (@Jeroen, thank
you).
c. It was pretty easy to get the VM set up thanks to their short
videos (on Youtube). The thing I almost missed was that I had to set
up another "endpoint" named "http" on port 80 (both public and
private) to enable Apache to work.
d. Then I was able to SSH into my new VM from my Mac Terminal.
e. Then I followed steps 1-8 in an earlier post on RApache
Installation (@EricSonghill, thank you).

I ran into some problems about step 8 on installing the Brew package
because it wouldn't let me write to the file.

I'm assuming the reason is that R was not installed as a shared
library in step 2 (as specified in the RApache Documentation).

Can anyone verify my theory?

On Jul 29, 3:30 am, Jeroen Ooms <jeroeno...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > Which linux version do you suggest I use?
>
> Ubuntu 12.04
